risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to commodity price volatility (cocoa, dairy, wheat, vegetable oils, sugar), which can impact its production costs and profit margins. This volatility is driven by factors such as weather conditions, geopolitical events, and currency fluctuations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 150 countries and is exposed to geopolitical risks, including conflicts, sanctions, and trade restrictions. The war in Ukraine has impacted operations and accounts for 0.4% of revenue. Operations in Russia (3.7% of revenue) remain exposed to risks of expropriation or asset loss. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector and faces pricing and product quality pressures. It must adapt to market changes to remain competitive. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Commercial and regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations and trade restrictions in the countries where it operates. Changes in trade and tariff policies, including increased U.S. tariffs since January 2026, may impact costs and the ability to operate in certain countries. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyberattack risks, which could impact data confidentiality and corporate reputation. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Inflation and operating costs
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to inflation and cost fluctuations (raw materials, labor, energy). Inflationary pressures have continued to rise and affect profitability, particularly cocoa costs, which remain elevated compared to historical levels. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Reputation and compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to reputational damage risks, which could impact its ability to attract and retain customers. Operations in geopolitical conflict zones may also pose compliance challenges. (default score, to be refined)
